remarks: REVITALIZE AND REFRESH this spacious home and breathe some new life into it! Located in a convenient and well-established area, this is a wonderful opportunity to roll up your sleeves and express your creativity with large rooms and a great floor plan to work with! There is both a living room plus a sunken family room with corner fireplace which offer comfortable spaces for both everyday living and entertaining, and 4 generously-sized bedrooms with hardwood flooring and ample closet space unheard of in today's newer homes. Needs kitchen and bath updates, some floor covering, attention to the exterior and overall general maintenance, but well worth the investment and effort for this desirable Amherst location! Offers presented as received but seller reserves the right to set a deadline.[NOTE: Sump pump certification to be the responsibility of the buyer after closing; seller to credit $1500 to buyer at closing to offset the cost of the required Waiver of Certificate of Compliance. Notice of Non-Compliance and estimate to remedy available in attachments.]
